Bode Creative - Bali Marketing & Operations Team

Company: Bode Creative (division of Bode Group)
Location: Bali, Indonesia
Founded: By Lisa Sibley

Mission: Provide businesses with a complete in-house marketing and operations team without the overhead of building one directly.

Services:
- Marketing & Social Media: Strategy, daily content production, account administration, paid advertising across Meta and Google
- Digital & Web: Website design, build, maintenance, SEO, analytics, Google Business management
- Creative Production: Photography, videography, design (produced in-house)
- Operational & Business Support: Systems design, reporting, consultancy on commercial decisions

Key Differentiator: Embedded team model that stays accountable for results, not just deliverables. Works as client's own staff would.

Background: Team assembled and trained while running luxury villa portfolio in Bali, managing distribution across booking platforms, direct-booking systems, guest conversion, operational reporting.

Target Industries: Hospitality, wellness, healthcare, food and beverage, property
